import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Normalize island label variants (case/extra spaces)
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip().str.title().replace({'nan': np.nan})
    # Flipper length: negative values are sign errors; take absolute value
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce').abs()
    # Body mass written as text with commas -> numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(
        df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False),
        errors='coerce'
    )
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    d = df.dropna(subset=['species', 'flipper_length_mm'])
    g = d.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
    return {k: float(v) for k, v in g.items()}
